technology_name: Reusable Test Strip for Colorimetric Detection of Fluoride Ions
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Colorimetric Chemical Sensor / Reusable Test Strip
problem_solved: Traditional fluoride ion detection requires destructive testing methods or specialized lab machinery that cannot perform field measurements. This test strip delivers visual colorimetric readings with a reusable 1:1 complex via hydrogen bonding.
description: Development of a highly selective, reusable solid-state test paper strip infused with a structurally tailored 4,4-Difluoro-4-bora-3a,4a-diaza-s-indacene (BODIPY) macrocyclic derivative that changes color upon interacting with fluoride ions in polar aprotic media.
applications: Field water-quality testing, industrial effluent monitoring, public health fluoride screening kits, and environmental toxicology.
secondary_sector: Water, Environment & Waste Management, MedTech & Health Care
